smp_intro_body: E kākau a hoʻopili paha i kekahi ʻōlelo a loaʻa 3 unuhi like ka manawa — kūlana kiʻekiʻe, maʻamau a me kaulike — e like me ka pōʻaiapili, me ka nānā huaʻōlelo, nā huaʻōlelo like a me kahi AI e pane i kāu mau nīnau unuhi.
